articles.title: Hormuz traffic drops to lowest since May
articles.summary: Hormuz traffic drops to lowest since May An average of 10 commodity ships transited the Strait of Hormuz daily over the past 10 days, marking the lowest traffic in the waterway since May, shipping data by Kpler on Monday showed. The 10-day moving average was 10 on Sunday, down from more than nearly 13 on Saturday. Meanwhile, only two vessels passed through the strait on Saturday while six others went through on Sunday, mostly using the Iranian route.
